looksLike: RecentlyViewed renders nothing on the server, then reads localStorage in a mount effect and immediately sets state, an extra render that looks like a hydration workaround or a wasted commit.
whyCorrect: localStorage only exists in the browser, so reading it after mount is the hydration-safe way to show per-visitor content; the second render carries new ids and the third the fetched products, so each update has a real input change.
